review.title: Agent review
review.description: What an agent changed, grouped by run. Approve what should stay, or put a whole run back.
review.blankDescription: When an agent writes content — over MCP or the agent API — its run appears here with everything it changed, ready to approve or revert.
review.revertConfirm: Undo everything this run changed? Deleted posts go to the trash, published pages are taken down, and anything that cannot be undone will be listed.
